hook_text: From space at night, some parts of the Earth blaze with light and others are completely dark. Why?
clip_script: A satellite photo of the Earth at night. Bright clusters over India, China, Europe and the east of the United States. A glowing line along the River Nile through dark desert. In South Africa, a bright patch around Gauteng and lights along the coast. Huge dark spaces over the Sahara, the Amazon, Siberia and Antarctica. Lights show where people live. People settle where there is water, good land, a pleasant climate, jobs and transport.
visual_style: Whiteboard Earth at night with glowing dots, zooming in on the Nile and on Gauteng, then two lists building up: natural reasons and human reasons.
mood: Curious and wide-eyed, like looking down from a spaceship.
pacing: A slow reveal of the night picture, then a clear sort of reasons into two groups.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and list three reasons why your family lives where it does.
